question.text: SEBI introduced the centralized reporting and verification mechanism for an investor's demise through which entities?

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI introduced the centralized reporting and verification mechanism through KRAs (KYC Registration Agencies). Verification of the death certificate, however, is performed by the concerned intermediary; the KRA receives the resulting KYC modification/status updates. The Trap: Treating KRAs as the entity that performs the verification can misstate the workflow; KRAs are the central reporting channel, while the concerned intermediary verifies the death certificate. Note: The Series VI workbook (pp.126-127) is the controlling source for KRAs being the centralized reporting/verification mechanism, with the concerned intermediary performing death-certificate verification and the KRA receiving KYC modification updates.
